learning_outcomes.text: Acquisition of fundamental knowledge of technical graphics.
Solving problems of projective representation of basic elements that make up parts.
Initiation into the principles underlying the determination of their true sizes and the intersection curves between volumes.
Using the conventional framework of ISO technical graphic representations, aiming to develop working habits based on norms and standards.

syllabus_topics: Graphic methods for determining true size for line segments and plane figures
Representation of basic geometric bodies necessary for part modeling
Development of volumes bounded by surfaces
Principles for determining intersection figures between two volumes
Representation of parts by views, sections, breaks
Demountable assemblies with standardized assembly elements
DT Preparation of execution drawings for parts of increasing complexity, relevation and drawing emphasizing modeling based on decomposition into simple geometries
DT Assembly drawings based on relevation
DT Assembly drawings based on exploded representations

assessment_methods.method: Two verification tests during the semester (Course)
Two verification tests during the semester (Applied activities)

assessment_rules: Minimum performance standard requires: GD knowledge of how to represent point, line, and plane. GD knowledge of how to represent geometric bodies of pyramid, prism, cylinder, cone type (sectioned or not). GD knowledge of descriptive geometry methods for determining the true size of sections in bodies, and of edges or generatrices of bodies. DT knowledge of how to represent external and internal threads. DT knowledge of how to represent a part in half-section.
